title: Phase 2: Production-source architecture conformance
status_detail: Inactive Phase 2; exact auditor, fixture, policy, and migration child Tasks remain deferred until the Phase 1 result is accepted and this phase is explicitly activated.
objective: Provide explicit-input, read-only production-source architecture inspection and a controlled migration ratchet for the accepted Python architecture policy.
authorized_scope: After an accepted Phase 1 result and separate activation, design and implement exact source facts and policy checks for the selected production architecture rules without ambient discovery or automatic repair.

Report supported-export agreement, prohibited dangling callables, private-owner policy, cross-object private access, dependency direction, import cycles, and accepted structural signals with stable source attribution and deterministic ordering.

Use controlled positive and negative fixtures, explicit policy and profile identities, and a migration ratchet that exposes inherited findings without waivers becoming permanent architecture authority.
Keep behavioral verification, scientific validity, promotion, public-contract decisions, and domain responsibility with their existing owners.
completion_criteria: The accepted production-source architecture policy is represented by deterministic explicit-input checks with complete controlled fixtures and stable findings.
The conformance implementation distinguishes enforceable rules from review-only metrics and does not infer separation of concerns or valid abstraction from syntax alone.
Focused tests, strict typing, lint, affected Harness checks, documentation, and generated projection agreement pass with inherited findings and limitations reported exactly.
Administrative closeout records the bounded conformance result and leaves the public-import and refactor phases inactive unless separately selected.
exclusions: Do not silently extend the existing test-evidence subject family, rewrite source, auto-generate public APIs, or make metric thresholds architectural truth without the accepted Phase 1 policy.
Do not create a generic architecture Manager, Helper, Processor, universal base class, mutable plugin registry, or second conformance authority.
Do not change scientific behavior, serialized meaning, dependencies, or existing public imports as part of conformance implementation.
No protected execution, release, automatic successor activation, staging, commit, or push is authorized by this inactive Task.
